title: Notes on the stave
summary: Read and write notes in all four clefs, including ledger lines.

provenance.notes: Items drawn from the seeded generators with a teaching-point filter, then fixed. Music and answers come from the rule engine; prompts and feedback are original.

music.textAlternative: A treble-clef stave with one semibreve on the 4th line.

hints: Find the clef's reference note first (G on line 2 in treble, F on line 4 in bass).
Count lines and spaces from the bottom.
The note is on the 4th line. The bottom line of the treble clef is E: count up (or down) one letter for each line and space.

feedback.correct: Yes! You read the treble-clef note from its line or space.

mistakes.line-space-swap: Look closely: is the line running through the note-head, or is the note sitting between two lines?
mistakes.clef-confusion: That would be right in another clef. Check the clef at the start of the stave first.
mistakes.counted-from-top: Lines and spaces are counted from the bottom of the stave upwards.
mistakes.off-by-step: You're one step away. Find a note you know for certain and count up or down from it.
mistakes.ledger-miscount: Count the ledger lines one at a time, from the stave outwards.
mistakes.accidental-ignored: The letter is right, but check for a sharp, flat or natural — in the key signature or in front of the note.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Start from the clef and count from a note you know.

music.textAlternative: A bass-clef stave with one semibreve on the 2nd ledger line below the stave.

hints: Count ledger lines from the stave outward.
The note is on the 2nd ledger line below the stave. The bottom line of the bass clef is G: count up (or down) one letter for each line and space.

feedback.correct: Correct. Counting the ledger lines one at a time pays off.

items.prompt: Write B in the bass clef. You may use up to 1 ledger line. Any B that fits is correct.
hints: Start from the clef's reference line.
Middle C needs one ledger line.
In the bass clef the bottom line is G. Count up one letter for each line and space until you reach B.

feedback.correct: Well placed. The bass clef's bottom line is G.

mistakes.wrong-octave: That's the right letter name, but in a different octave. Check which one the question asks for.
mistakes.line-space-swap: Nearly — move it between a line and a space and check again.
mistakes.clef-confusion: That position would be right in a different clef. Look at the clef first.
mistakes.ledger-miscount: Count the ledger lines needed — one for each line above or below the stave.
mistakes.counted-from-top: Lines and spaces are counted from the bottom of the stave upwards.
mistakes.accidental-missing: The position is right, but the note needs its sharp, flat or natural.

feedback.fallback: Not quite. Find a reference note and count lines and spaces from it.
